blind.description: A stylized fantasy balance scale featuring a base formed from stacked gold coins, a central pointed pillar, and a balance beam supporting two suspended shallow circular pans. The metalwork is polished gold/brass with deep emerald-green enamel or stone insets on the central pillar, beam, and pan interiors. All surfaces are smooth, continuous, and solidly modeled in a clean stylized game-art aesthetic with no disconnected floating pieces or melted artifacts.
blind.from_above: A straight horizontal bar with a central diamond-shaped cap, flanked on left and right by round green-lined circular dishes attached via triangular top struts, set over a circular coin base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 to 1/5 as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1 to 1.3 feet tall) and roughly 1.3 feet wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.45x off the catalog (2.5 x 1.0 ft)
